response.description:
Azure Databricks Runtime
10.4 LTS, a Databricks-managed runtime available on Azure Databricks, reached
end of support on March 18, 2025 and will reach end of life on November 1, 2026. After this date,
Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will no longer be available or usable, and
workloads remaining on this version will no longer run. To avoid disruption,
migrate affected clusters and workloads to a supported Databricks Runtime
version before November 1, 2026. Learn
more.
response.title: Announcing: Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will reach end of life on November 1, 2026
